List all layer groups

Source: R/gq_groups.R
gq_groups.Rd

Returns a data.frame of all groups defined in the registry, with their member layers, subgroups, and z-order. Each row is one layer-to-group mapping.

Usage

gq_groups(registry = NULL)

Arguments

registry

Optional registry list (from gq_reg_main()). If provided, source_layer and type columns are joined from the style registry.

Value

A data.frame with columns: group, subgroup, layer_key, order, and optionally source_layer and type.

Examples

# All groups and their layers
gq_groups()
